subject: Figurative constant values
notes: Rule: 'The quote format represents one or more of the quotation mark character ' " ' in the computer's runtime coded character set. The word QUOTE or QUOTES shall not be used in place of a quotation symbol to bound a literal.' (cite.py --check 8.3.3.6.4 -> OK 8)). First half: FillChar 'Q' -> '"' (both classes); probe probe/figurative-constant-values/p1.cob MOVE QUOTE TO PIC X(3)/PIC N(3) -> '"""|"""', DISPLAY QUOTE -> '"'. Second half: the lexer recognizes literal delimiters only as quotation symbols (§8.3.5 SR5); QUOTE is a figurative token (KindOf) with no delimiter role anywhere in the grammar, so it cannot bound a literal. No spec-derived test isolates the quote character; test-needed.
